<!-- This page indexes workshop repositories from the c3g GitHub organization and partners' GitHub repositories. The list data/workshops-data.json is created with the python script scripts/fetch_workshops_data.py. Edit the python script to include more partner repositories and uncomment the pre-render section in _quarto.yml to update this table. -->

## Workshops Catalog

This page indexes workshop repositories from the [c3g GitHub organization](https://github.com/c3g).
Only repositories whose names start with `c3gW` and include the `workshop` topic are included.

<div class="workshop-index-controls">
<label for="workshopFilter">Filter workshops</label>
<input id="workshopFilter" type="search" placeholder="Type to filter by name or description" />
</div>

<div id="workshopTopicFilters" class="workshop-topic-filters" aria-label="Filter by workshop topic"></div>

<div id="workshopStatus" class="workshop-index-status" aria-live="polite">Loading workshops...</div>
<div id="workshopList" class="workshop-index-list"></div>

<script>
	(async function () {
		const normalizedPrefix = "c3gw";
		const normalizedTopicTag = "workshop";
		const defaultSuggestedCategoryTags = ["cancer", "rna-seq", "chip-seq", "metagenomics", "variant-calling", "single-cell", "epigenomics", "proteomics", "genome-assembly", "clinical"];
		const statusEl = document.getElementById("workshopStatus");
		const listEl = document.getElementById("workshopList");
		const filterEl = document.getElementById("workshopFilter");
		const topicFiltersEl = document.getElementById("workshopTopicFilters");

		if (!statusEl || !listEl || !filterEl || !topicFiltersEl) {
			console.error("Workshop index container elements are missing from the page.");
			return;
		}

		async function fetchCatalogData() {
			const response = await fetch("./data/workshops-data.json", { cache: "no-store" });

			if (!response.ok) {
				throw new Error(`Catalog data request failed with status ${response.status}`);
			}

			return response.json();
		}

		function getNonWorkshopTopics(repo) {
			const topics = Array.isArray(repo.topics) ? repo.topics : [];
			return topics.filter((topic) => topic !== normalizedTopicTag);
		}

		function hasWorkshopTopic(repo) {
			const topics = Array.isArray(repo.topics) ? repo.topics : [];
			return topics.some((topic) => String(topic).toLowerCase() === normalizedTopicTag);
		}

		function formatDate(isoDate) {
			if (!isoDate) {
				return "Unknown update date";
			}

			const parsed = new Date(isoDate);
			return parsed.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
				year: "numeric",
				month: "short",
				day: "numeric"
			});
		}

		function renderCards(items) {
			if (items.length === 0) {
				listEl.innerHTML = "";
				statusEl.textContent = "No workshops match this filter.";
				return;
			}

			const cards = items.map((repo) => {
				const description = repo.description
					? repo.description
					: "No description provided.";
				const homepage = repo.homepage && repo.homepage.trim() !== ""
					? `<a href="${repo.homepage}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Website</a>`
					: "";
				const tags = Array.isArray(repo.topics) ? repo.topics : [];
				const tagsMarkup = tags.length > 0
					? `<div class="workshop-tags">${tags.map((tag) => `<span class="workshop-tag">${tag}</span>`).join("")}</div>`
					: "<div class=\"workshop-tags\"><span class=\"workshop-tag workshop-tag-empty\">untagged</span></div>";

				return `
					<article class="workshop-card">
						<h3><a href="${repo.html_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${repo.name}</a></h3>
						<p>${description}</p>
						${tagsMarkup}
						<div class="workshop-meta">
							<span>Updated ${formatDate(repo.pushed_at)}</span>
							<a href="${repo.html_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub</a>
							${homepage}
						</div>
					</article>
				`;
			});

			listEl.innerHTML = cards.join("");
			statusEl.textContent = `${items.length} workshop repositories found.`;
		}

		function buildTopicFilters(workshops, suggestedCategoryTags) {
			const discoveredTopics = new Set();
			const excludedTopicKeys = new Set(["training", "other"]);

			workshops.forEach((repo) => {
				getNonWorkshopTopics(repo).forEach((topic) => discoveredTopics.add(topic));
			});

			suggestedCategoryTags.forEach((topic) => discoveredTopics.add(topic));

			const topicButtons = [
				{ key: "all", label: "All" },
				...Array.from(discoveredTopics)
					.filter((topic) => !excludedTopicKeys.has(topic))
					.sort()
					.map((topic) => ({
					key: topic,
					label: topic
				}))
			];

			topicFiltersEl.innerHTML = topicButtons
				.map((topic) => `<button type="button" class="workshop-topic-button" data-topic-key="${topic.key}">${topic.label}</button>`)
				.join("");
		}

		function filterByTopic(workshops, topicKey) {
			if (topicKey === "all") {
				return workshops;
			}

			if (topicKey === "other") {
				return workshops.filter((repo) => getNonWorkshopTopics(repo).length === 0);
			}

			return workshops.filter((repo) => getNonWorkshopTopics(repo).includes(topicKey));
		}

		function setActiveTopicButton(topicKey) {
			const buttons = topicFiltersEl.querySelectorAll(".workshop-topic-button");

			buttons.forEach((button) => {
				button.classList.toggle("is-active", button.dataset.topicKey === topicKey);
			});
		}

		try {
			const payload = await fetchCatalogData();
			const suggestedCategoryTags = Array.isArray(payload.suggestedCategoryTags) && payload.suggestedCategoryTags.length > 0
				? payload.suggestedCategoryTags
				: defaultSuggestedCategoryTags;
			const repos = Array.isArray(payload.mainWorkshops) ? payload.mainWorkshops : [];
			const workshops = repos
				.map((repo) => ({
					...repo,
					topics: Array.isArray(repo.topics)
						? repo.topics.map((topic) => String(topic).toLowerCase())
						: []
				}))
				.filter((repo) => String(repo.name || "").toLowerCase().startsWith(normalizedPrefix))
				.filter((repo) => hasWorkshopTopic(repo))
				.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

			buildTopicFilters(workshops, suggestedCategoryTags);

			let selectedTopicKey = "all";

			const applyFilters = () => {
				const query = filterEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
				const topicFiltered = filterByTopic(workshops, selectedTopicKey);

				const combined = query
					? topicFiltered.filter((repo) => {
						const haystack = `${repo.name} ${repo.description || ""}`.toLowerCase();
						return haystack.includes(query);
					})
					: topicFiltered;

				renderCards(combined);
				setActiveTopicButton(selectedTopicKey);
			};

			applyFilters();

			filterEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
				applyFilters();
			});

			topicFiltersEl.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
				const target = event.target;

				if (!(target instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) {
					return;
				}

				const nextTopicKey = target.dataset.topicKey;
				if (!nextTopicKey) {
					return;
				}

				selectedTopicKey = nextTopicKey;
				applyFilters();
			});
		} catch (error) {
			listEl.innerHTML = "";
			statusEl.textContent = "Unable to load prebuilt workshop catalog data. Please ask a contributor to run the build again.";

			console.error(error);
		}
	})();
</script>

## Partner Workshops
C3G also collaborates with partner organizations to deliver workshops. This section highlights partner-led workshops in which C3G is involved. Although these workshops may not be hosted in the C3G GitHub organization, they remain relevant to our community.

<!-- Partner repositories are configured at build time in `scripts/fetch_workshops_data.py`. -->

<div class="workshop-index-controls">
<label for="partnerWorkshopFilter">Filter partner workshops</label>
<input id="partnerWorkshopFilter" type="search" placeholder="Type to filter by name or description" />
</div>

<div id="partnerWorkshopTopicFilters" class="workshop-topic-filters" aria-label="Filter partner workshops by topic"></div>

<div id="partnerWorkshopStatus" class="workshop-index-status" aria-live="polite">Loading partner workshops...</div>
<div id="partnerWorkshopList" class="workshop-index-list"></div>

<script>
	(async function () {
		const topicTag = "workshop";
		const normalizedTopicTag = topicTag.toLowerCase();
		const defaultSuggestedCategoryTags = ["cancer", "rna-seq", "chip-seq", "metagenomics", "variant-calling", "single-cell", "epigenomics", "proteomics", "genome-assembly", "clinical"];
		const statusEl = document.getElementById("partnerWorkshopStatus");
		const listEl = document.getElementById("partnerWorkshopList");
		const filterEl = document.getElementById("partnerWorkshopFilter");
		const topicFiltersEl = document.getElementById("partnerWorkshopTopicFilters");

		if (!statusEl || !listEl || !filterEl || !topicFiltersEl) {
			console.error("Partner workshop index container elements are missing from the page.");
			return;
		}

		async function fetchCatalogData() {
			const response = await fetch("./data/workshops-data.json", { cache: "no-store" });

			if (!response.ok) {
				throw new Error(`Catalog data request failed with status ${response.status}`);
			}

			return response.json();
		}

		function getNonWorkshopTopics(repo) {
			const topics = Array.isArray(repo.topics) ? repo.topics : [];
			return topics.filter((topic) => topic !== normalizedTopicTag);
		}

		function formatDate(isoDate) {
			if (!isoDate) {
				return "Unknown update date";
			}

			const parsed = new Date(isoDate);
			return parsed.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
				year: "numeric",
				month: "short",
				day: "numeric"
			});
		}

		function renderCards(items) {
			if (items.length === 0) {
				listEl.innerHTML = "";
				statusEl.textContent = "No partner workshops match this filter.";
				return;
			}

			const cards = items.map((repo) => {
				const description = repo.description
					? repo.description
					: "No description provided.";
				const homepage = repo.homepage && repo.homepage.trim() !== ""
					? `<a href="${repo.homepage}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Website</a>`
					: "";
				const tags = Array.isArray(repo.topics) ? repo.topics : [];
				const tagsMarkup = tags.length > 0
					? `<div class="workshop-tags">${tags.map((tag) => `<span class="workshop-tag">${tag}</span>`).join("")}</div>`
					: "<div class=\"workshop-tags\"><span class=\"workshop-tag workshop-tag-empty\">untagged</span></div>";

				return `
					<article class="workshop-card">
						<h3><a href="${repo.html_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${repo.full_name || repo.name}</a></h3>
						<p>${description}</p>
						${tagsMarkup}
						<div class="workshop-meta">
							<span>Updated ${formatDate(repo.pushed_at)}</span>
							<a href="${repo.html_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub</a>
							${homepage}
						</div>
					</article>
				`;
			});

			listEl.innerHTML = cards.join("");
			statusEl.textContent = `${items.length} partner workshop repositories found.`;
		}

		function buildTopicFilters(workshops, suggestedCategoryTags) {
			const discoveredTopics = new Set();

			workshops.forEach((repo) => {
				getNonWorkshopTopics(repo).forEach((topic) => discoveredTopics.add(topic));
			});

			suggestedCategoryTags.forEach((topic) => discoveredTopics.add(topic));

			const topicButtons = [
				{ key: "all", label: "All" },
				...Array.from(discoveredTopics)
					.sort()
					.map((topic) => ({
						key: topic,
						label: topic
					}))
			];

			topicFiltersEl.innerHTML = topicButtons
				.map((topic) => `<button type="button" class="workshop-topic-button" data-topic-key="${topic.key}">${topic.label}</button>`)
				.join("");
		}

		function filterByTopic(workshops, topicKey) {
			if (topicKey === "all") {
				return workshops;
			}

			return workshops.filter((repo) => getNonWorkshopTopics(repo).includes(topicKey));
		}

		function setActiveTopicButton(topicKey) {
			const buttons = topicFiltersEl.querySelectorAll(".workshop-topic-button");

			buttons.forEach((button) => {
				button.classList.toggle("is-active", button.dataset.topicKey === topicKey);
			});
		}

		try {
			const payload = await fetchCatalogData();
			const manualPartnerRepoList = payload.source && Array.isArray(payload.source.manualPartnerRepoList)
				? payload.source.manualPartnerRepoList
				: [];
			const suggestedCategoryTags = Array.isArray(payload.suggestedCategoryTags) && payload.suggestedCategoryTags.length > 0
				? payload.suggestedCategoryTags
				: defaultSuggestedCategoryTags;
			const workshops = (Array.isArray(payload.partnerWorkshops) ? payload.partnerWorkshops : [])
				.map((repo) => ({
					...repo,
					topics: Array.isArray(repo.topics)
						? repo.topics.map((topic) => String(topic).toLowerCase())
						: []
				}));

			if (manualPartnerRepoList.length === 0) {
				statusEl.textContent = "No partner repositories configured yet. Add entries to MANUAL_PARTNER_REPO_LIST in scripts/fetch_workshops_data.py.";
				listEl.innerHTML = "";
				topicFiltersEl.innerHTML = "";
				return;
			}

			buildTopicFilters(workshops, suggestedCategoryTags);

			let selectedTopicKey = "all";

			const applyFilters = () => {
				const query = filterEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
				const topicFiltered = filterByTopic(workshops, selectedTopicKey);

				const combined = query
					? topicFiltered.filter((repo) => {
						const haystack = `${repo.name} ${repo.full_name || ""} ${repo.description || ""}`.toLowerCase();
						return haystack.includes(query);
					})
					: topicFiltered;

				renderCards(combined);
				setActiveTopicButton(selectedTopicKey);
			};

			applyFilters();

			filterEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
				applyFilters();
			});

			topicFiltersEl.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
				const target = event.target;

				if (!(target instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) {
					return;
				}

				const nextTopicKey = target.dataset.topicKey;
				if (!nextTopicKey) {
					return;
				}

				selectedTopicKey = nextTopicKey;
				applyFilters();
			});
		} catch (error) {
			listEl.innerHTML = "";
			statusEl.textContent = "Unable to load prebuilt partner workshop catalog data. Please ask a contributor to run the build again.";

			console.error(error);
		}
	})();
</script>
